decisions.reason: As a low-cost extension of the established format portfolio with still-unresolved market uncertainty, the option remains open.
The digital twin market is still emerging and keeping costs are low, so the option has value despite uncertain demand.
This general authentication service overlaps with the GIS-specific identity service and has not shown distinct value, so we abandon it.
Aligned with the core GIS offer and with low incremental cost, the identity and access service remains a valuable option.
The recently launched consulting workshop has its own page and still-high uncertainty at modest cost, so we keep the option open.
